svg.title: 44% of possible zone-hours actually happened
svg.desc: A grid representing 265 zones down the side and 24 hours across the top, 6,360 total possible zone-hour cells. A shaded region covering 44% of the grid represents 2,814 zone-hours that had at least one real trip. The remaining 56%, unshaded, represents 3,546 zone-hours that dbt_utils.date_spine crossed with the zones dimension revealed as genuinely empty -- combinations no group by query could ever surface, since a group by only reports on rows that already exist. A caption states this coverage report answers a question no earlier module asked: not what happened, but what didn't.
svg.text: A date_spine Crossed With Every Zone Reveals What Never Happened

g.text: never visible to any group by

svg.text: Why a group by alone can't see this
1. int_trips_summed_to_hour groups only the rows that exist
-- 2,814 zone-hours, one per real trip group
independent of whether any trip happened in them
3. Crossed against all 265 zones, then left-joined
against real trip data -- 3,546 rows come back with
trip_count = 0, not absent from the result at all
A coverage report answers a question no earlier module asked:
not what happened, but what didn't.
